title: Audit canonical requirements lost after the last change is archived
description: Audit canonical requirements lost after the last change is archived
acceptance_criteria: With no active changes, both change audit and check --strict report each unexplained canonical requirement loss, its original file and a concrete restore command. The same commands pass on a separate no-loss control. Removals authorized on the branch and requirements moved under the same ID pass. Both entry points disclose a missing comparison ref and give fetch guidance when the known comparison history is incomplete.

answers.constraints: Reuse REQ-change-169 for selection, removal accounting and bounded reads. Preserve archive-first CI ordering and the existing required Lifecycle gate. Keep ordinary check focused on spec-to-code drift. Strict check shares the historical loss check without importing the rest of lifecycle audit.
